audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase why-text pointed at Miasma without giving its cooldown, and sequencingCues was 1 for the whole matchup.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s and it is the only thing in her kit that stops Vayne — it grounds, so Tumble is disabled inside it. The 24 seconds after she spends it is literally the whole all-in window, and the page never printed the number.
audit.corrected: Miasma 24s at rank 1 stated in phases[3].why, dontsFull[1].d and spikes[0]. Noxious Blast is 3.5s flat, Twin Fang 0.75s, Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80s. Vayne's spikes stay Tumble at 2-3, Bork first item, Final Hour and two items late.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] and mid both say to walk her down "between Twin Fang (Q) casts". Twin Fang is her E, not her Q, and at 0.75s it has no gap to walk between — the Q is Noxious Blast at 3.5s. The applicable anti-heal interaction was also absent: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of damage dealt whenever she hits a poisoned target.
audit.why: This is the same class of error the run's calibration notes flag on Cassiopeia. Telling a player to time their walk-up against a 0.75s ability is advice they cannot act on, and it hides the real rhythm, which is her poison application. The healing is what makes her win extended exchanges and it decides when Executioner's Calling is bought.
audit.corrected: Walk her down between Noxious Blast (Q) casts; Twin Fang (E) is the 0.75s follow-up that only ramps on poisoned targets and heals her off it. Miasma (W) grounds — no Tumble inside it. Petrifying Gaze (R) stuns only enemies facing her; anyone with their back turned is slowed instead, so turn away on the cast.
